caption: A bottle from the fridge and an identical bottle from a cupboard stand side by side on a warm counter, and only the cold one beads with water.

sa.check: Two identical bottles stand side by side on a counter.
One bottle has come from a fridge and reads as cold.
Mist and then drops form on the cold bottle.
Drops run down the cold bottle.
The counter wets beneath the cold bottle.

pc.expect: The beading appears only on the cold bottle and the other stays dry throughout.
pc.fail: The room-temperature bottle beads while the cold one stays dry; or both bottles bead equally; or neither bottle beads at all while one is plainly frosted from the fridge; or the dry bottle's label wets while its glass stays dry.

pc.expect: The beading on the cold bottle only builds while it stays cold: drops grow, join and run.
pc.fail: The drops shrink or go while the bottle stays cold and frosted; or the cold bottle beads and dries in turn; or the beading eases while the frost is still on it; or the drops turn back into dry white frost on the warm counter.

pc.expect: Drops that grow large enough run downward on the cold bottle and wet the counter beneath it.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the bottle; or water gathers on the cap's top and stays; or a drop leaves the bottle and rises; or a run travels sideways round the bottle and stays level.

pc.expect: The beads behave as water on glass: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the counter darkens where it wets.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the glass; or the counter stays dry-looking under a spreading pool; or the beads stand as tall columns on the glass.

pc.expect: Two bottles on one counter; the water on the cold bottle comes out of the air and its contents stay inside.
pc.fail: The cold bottle's level drops as the pool grows; or beads form on the inside of a bottle; or a third bottle appears; or a bottle passes through the counter.

pc.expect: The bottles' labels, their caps and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: A label changes; or a cap changes colour; or items on the counter rearrange.
